svg.title: Configuration and compiler warning options
svg.desc: Only tidy options and warning handling move into the listener; frontend startup stays in ParsedAST. Action, MainInput, BeginSourceFile and the beforeBeginSourceFile hook loop remain unchanged. Use clangd's remapped main-file spelling; normalize only a relative fallback before configuration lookup. Frontend startup and beforeBeginSourceFile dispatch remain in ParsedAST. The remapped main-file buffer preserves the requested filename for configuration lookup.
svg.text: Only tidy options and warning handling move into the listener; frontend startup stays in ParsedAST. Action, MainInput, BeginSourceFile and the
beforeBeginSourceFile hook loop remain unchanged. Use clangd's remapped main-file spelling; normalize only a relative fallback before
// Warning options must precede frontend initialization: module loading in
// BeginSourceFile() can consult their severity to decide whether to fail.
elog("Cannot configure clang-tidy without a main-file input");
// The remapped buffer carries clangd's original main-file spelling.
// Providers search parent directories for .clang-tidy and require an
// absolute path. Respect the compiler's working directory, not clangd's.
elog("Cannot resolve clang-tidy input path: {0}", Path);
Frontend startup and beforeBeginSourceFile dispatch remain in ParsedAST.
The remapped main-file buffer preserves the requested filename for configuration lookup.
Source: 101584320859 → c64f1fca38c6 • Exact snapshots; arrows map responsibilities, not every line
